mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member (name, email, password, birth_date, nationality, phone, gender, active, created_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{email}, #{password}, #{birthDate}, #{nationality}, #{phone}, #{gender}, #{active}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))
mapper.select: SELECT name, email, password, birth_date, nationality, phone, gender, active, created_at FROM member WHERE email = #{email} and active = true
